question: Where is attraction positioned within 70 kilometers when moving from Joyce Gordon Gallery, Oakland, CA toward YOTEL San Francisco, San Francisco, CA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Joyce Gordon Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Oakland%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%YOTEL San Francisco%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), bearings AS ( SELECT s.geometry AS start_geom, e.geometry AS end_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry)) AS target_bearing FROM start_point s, end_point e ), search_cone AS ( SELECT start_geom, target_bearing, -- Define a 90-degree cone (+/- 45 degrees) around the target bearing (target_bearing - 45 + 360) % 360 AS min_bearing, (target_bearing + 45) % 360 AS max_bearing FROM bearings ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, search_cone sc WHERE p.tourism = 'attraction' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sc.start_geom::geography, 70000) -- within 70 kilometers (70000 meters) AND ( CASE WHEN sc.min_bearing <= sc.max_bearing THEN -- Normal angular range (e.g., 30 to 120 degrees) degrees(ST_Azimuth(sc.start_geom, p.geometry)) >= sc.min_bearing AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(sc.start_geom, p.geometry)) <= sc.max_bearing ELSE -- Wrapped angular range (e.g., 330 to 60 degrees, crossing 0/360) degrees(ST_Azimuth(sc.start_geom, p.geometry)) >= sc.min_bearing OR degrees(ST_Azimuth(sc.start_geom, p.geometry)) <= sc.max_bearing END );
